messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Hydrangea Therapeutics asked whether we can onboard their custom adapter (vector connector) for a 3-week POC. They want bandwidth-optimized KV cache and pricing for sustained 200–300 QPS.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Nice. Do they want hosted or Dedicated/Private?
Maya (AE): Prefer hosted first, but they may require private later for PHI. For hosted: they want to pin a model variant that is quantized for cost.
Lee (Infra): Quick check — which model variant are they proposing?
Maya (AE): They submitted: `hydra-open-13b-q4f16` (community build). Also asked if our KV cache will be per-tenant and whether we throttle by token or request.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): For hosted: KV prefix caching is per-customer scope (we can namespace). Throttling is by token rate + concurrent request limits.
Sam (Sales Eng): Pricing ask: they want a ballpark for 200–300 QPS sustained, 8k context, quantized variant. Any estimates?
Lee (Infra): Rough back-of-envelope: model=13B q4 => ~16–20GB GPU memory in our optimized path. For 200–300 QPS sustained you either need heavy batching/rate shaping or Dedicated pool. With smart batching and prefix cache hit ~70%, hosted cost might be reasonable. But sustained 300 QPS with low tail latency likely needs Dedicated commit.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Adding concrete config they plan to use so we can size properly:
```yaml
model_variant: hydra-open-13b-q4f16
max_context_tokens: 8192
expected_qps: 250
kv_cache_enabled: true
cache_hit_rate: 0.7
batch_timeout_ms: 10
```
Maya (AE): They also asked if our routing can fall back to a smaller variant automatically on overload.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Yes — routing policies support fallback to compatible variants. We can set a policy: primary->hydra-13b-q4 -> fallback->hydra-7b-q4p
Sam (Sales Eng): Any enterprise blockers we should flag? They mentioned KMS integration and a security questionnaire.
Lee (Infra): KMS — Hosted supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration for encryption-at-rest of model artifacts and KV. For full KMS/HSM in private, that'll be a separate workstream. Questionnaire — ask them to file the standard security pack (link: https://redwood.internal/sec/sales-pack).
Maya (AE): They've got a compliance window — need POC running inside 3 weeks. What's feasible?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): If we do hosted with pinned model variant and a small Dedicated burst pool, we can start within 2 weeks: onboarding, quick scale tests, and run a pilot. Private will take longer (networking/KMS).
Sam (Sales Eng): Pricing options to propose: 1) Hosted pay-as-you-go with usage tiers (higher per-token but no commit); 2) Dedicated monthly commit (lower unit cost; recommended for sustained QPS); 3) Hybrid: hosted for dev + Dedicated for the POC windows. Which numbers to give them?
Lee (Infra): I'll sketch an estimate. Assumptions: 250 sustained QPS, 8k context, 70% cache hit, avg 256 tokens per request.
ops-bot: compute-estimate result: "estimated_gpu_hours_per_day": "48", "recommended_pool": "4x A100-equivalent", "notes": "estimate based on continuous batching and 70% cache hit"
Jordan (Solutions Eng): For clarity, give them two line items: capacity (Dedicated pool size) and expected monthly cost delta vs hosted. I can prepare a short sizing note.
Maya (AE): Also need to confirm model license/compat. Their variant is community-provided — do we allow arbitrary community variants in hosted?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): We have a model onboarding checklist. Community variants require a quick security scan and performance verification. For hosted, we need to verify the artifact, reproducible weights, and run a validation job. If anything odd, we can sandbox it in a Dedicated pool.
Sam (Sales Eng): Action items list I can send to Hydrangea: 1) Fill security pack; 2) Provide model artifact link + checksums; 3) Provide workload samples (prompts) and expected SLAs; 4) Confirm KMS needs.
Maya (AE): I'll message the customer with that list. Jordan/Lee — can you both do a short sizing + onboarding steps doc by EOD tomorrow?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Yep, I'll draft the validation/test steps and fallback policy snippet.
Lee (Infra): I'll dump a capacity sketch and rough price delta for Dedicated vs hosted.
Sam (Sales Eng): I'll include a pricing option in the outreach.
Maya (AE): Perfect. One quick FYI — they care about bandwidth from our KV cache to their VPC connectors. Any network egress costs to call out?
Lee (Infra): If hosted <-> customer VPC over private peering, egress depends on region/peering. For public hosted calls, outbound egress could apply. Note it in the pricing sheet.
Maya (AE): Thanks. I'll ping when Hydrangea sends the model link. :thumbsup:
